FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How do you spell it?
   B. How are you?
   C. And you?
   D. What is your name?

2. What does 'Monsieur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. well
   C. yes
   D. Sir, Mr

3. What does 'la sœur' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the family
   B. the brother
   C. the sister
   D. the baby

4. What does 'Qui est-ce ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Who is it?
   B. the girl
   C. the father
   D. the sister

5. What does 'la maison' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the TV
   C. the ball
   D. the house

6. How do you say 'It is a table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une table.
   B. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   C. Le livre est sur la table.
   D. Où est le chat ?

7. Fill in: Le livre est ______ la table. (on) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. entre
   C. sur
   D. dans

8. What does 'dimanche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Sunday
   D. Thursday

9. What does 'mardi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Friday
   C. Sunday
   D. Thursday

10. Which month is 'juillet'? (1 mark)
   A. October
   B. July
   C. March
   D. May

11. What number is 'trente et un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 4
   D. 5

12. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Bon anniversaire ! Kamau: Merci, Amina ! Amina: Tu as quel âge ? Kamau: J'ai dix ans. Amina: Voici un cadeau ! Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. eleven
   B. nine
   C. ten
   D. twelve

13. What does 'grand' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. long
   B. short
   C. tall, big
   D. black

14. How do you say 'I have two hands.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un nez.
   B. J'ai deux yeux.
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. Elle est petite.

15. What does 'Il pleut.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is freezing.
   B. It is windy.
   C. It is raining.
   D. It is cold.

16. What does 'près de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. straight ahead
   B. near
   C. to the left
   D. to the right

17. In the word salut, which letter is silent? (1 mark)
   A. t
   B. u
   C. s
   D. l

18. Which letter has a cedilla? (1 mark)
   A. ç
   B. ê
   C. é
   D. è

19. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: How many chairs are in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. two
   B. one
   C. three
   D. four

20. Which little word goes with 'gâteau' (the cake)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

21. Which little word goes with 'ballon' (the a balloon)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. les
   D. l'

22. Which little word goes with 'carotte' (the carrot)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

23. What does 'Le matin, je mange du pain.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. They are mangoes.
   B. It is good for your health.
   C. It is not good for your health.
   D. In the morning, I eat bread.

24. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: Is Amina tall or short? (1 mark)
   A. very small
   B. old
   C. tall
   D. short

25. What does 'J'ai une bouche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a mouth.
   B. I have ten fingers.
   C. He is tall.
   D. She has black hair.

26. What does 'Quel temps fait-il ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. What is the weather like?
   C. It is hot.
   D. It is snowing.

27. What does 'Allez tout droit.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me, where is the school?
   B. The rug is under the table.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Go straight ahead.

28. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'father'? (1 mark)
   A. pere
   B. pére
   C. pèe
   D. père

29. How do you say 'Where is ... ?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le livre
   B. le salon
   C. Où est ... ?
   D. derrière

30. Which sentence has the correct word order? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac sous est la chaise.
   B. Le sac est sous la chaise.
   C. Est le sac sous la chaise.
   D. Sous la chaise le est sac.

31. How do you say 'today' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je me repose
   C. demain
   D. aujourd'hui

32. How do you say 'Sunday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. dimanche
   B. lundi
   C. mercredi
   D. vendredi

33. How do you say 'I rest' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je me repose
   C. je danse
   D. demain

34. Which accent is on août? (1 mark)
   A. circonflexe
   B. aigu
   C. cédille
   D. grave

35. How do you say 'the mango' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'eau
   B. le maïs
   C. le lait
   D. la mangue

36. How do you say 'the leg' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. le genou
   C. le dos
   D. le ventre

37. How do you say 'the knee' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la main
   B. les cheveux
   C. l'épaule
   D. le genou

38. How do you say 'the stomach' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. le ventre
   C. l'épaule
   D. le pied

39. How do you say 'It is cloudy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il y a du vent.
   C. Il gèle.
   D. Il y a des nuages.

40. How do you say 'to the right' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à côté de
   B. près de
   C. à droite
   D. à gauche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Oui, ça va.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Il y a des nuages.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'De rien !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Write the French words for: a birthday, a month, a present (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'She is short.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'C'est un gâteau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'You are welcome!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix doigts.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'There is a sofa in the living room.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

51. Write the French words for: near, the rug, the key (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Write the French words for: in, the door, the chair (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'It is good for your health.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Write four sentences in French about your family. Use mon or ma correctly. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'It is hot.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'Salut, Kamau !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. List four things you find at a birthday party in French with un or une. (4 marks) (4 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'J'ai neuf ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into French: 'She has black hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'The TV is in the living room.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'This is my mother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: 'Il fait beau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

63. Translate into English: 'C'est mon frère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?.

2. D — Sir, Mr
   Monsieur means Sir, Mr.

3. C — the sister
   la sœur means the sister.

4. A — Who is it?
   Qui est-ce ? means Who is it?.

5. D — the house
   la maison means the house.

6. A — C'est une table.
   It is a table. in French is C'est une table.

7. C — sur
   Sur means on.

8. C — Sunday
   dimanche means Sunday.

9. A — Tuesday
   mardi means Tuesday.

10. B — July
   juillet means July.

11. B — 31
   trente et un means 31.

12. C — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

13. C — tall, big
   grand means tall, big.

14. C — J'ai deux mains.
   I have two hands. in French is J'ai deux mains.

15. C — It is raining.
   Il pleut. means It is raining..

16. B — near
   près de means near.

17. A — t
   The final t is silent in salut.

18. A — ç
   The cedilla is the tail under c.

19. A — two
   Deux chaises means two chairs.

20. C — le
   gâteau is masculine, so we say le gâteau.

21. A — le
   ballon is masculine, so we say le ballon.

22. A — la
   carotte is feminine, so we say la carotte.

23. D — In the morning, I eat bread.
   Le matin, je mange du pain. means In the morning, I eat bread.

24. C — tall
   Elle est grande.

25. A — I have a mouth.
   J'ai une bouche. means I have a mouth.

26. B — What is the weather like?
   Quel temps fait-il ? means What is the weather like?

27. D — Go straight ahead.
   Allez tout droit. means Go straight ahead.

28. D — père
   The correct spelling is père, with its accents.

29. C — Où est ... ?
   Where is ... ? in French is Où est ... ?.

30. B — Le sac est sous la chaise.
   The order is the thing, est, the position word, the place.

31. D — aujourd'hui
   today in French is aujourd'hui.

32. A — dimanche
   Sunday in French is dimanche.

33. B — je me repose
   I rest in French is je me repose.

34. A — circonflexe
   Août has a circumflex on the û.

35. D — la mangue
   the mango in French is la mangue.

36. A — la jambe
   the leg in French is la jambe.

37. D — le genou
   the knee in French is le genou.

38. B — le ventre
   the stomach in French is le ventre.

39. D — Il y a des nuages.
   It is cloudy. in French is Il y a des nuages..

40. C — à droite
   to the right in French is à droite.
